/bin/zsh -lc "cd \"/Users/sakiko/Library/Application Support/NipaPlay/LabProfiles/x40-agent-44306/harness\" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys
def bdecode(b,i=0):
    c=b[i:i+1]
    if c==b'i':
        j=b.index(b'e',i); return int(b[i+1:j]), j+1
    if c==b'l':
        i+=1; out=[]
        while b[i:i+1]"'!=b'"'e':
            v,i=bdecode(b,i); out.append(v)
        return out,i+1
    if c==b'd':
        i+=1; out={}
        while b[i:i+1]"'!=b'"'e':
            k,i=bdecode(b,i); v,i=bdecode(b,i); out[k]=v
        return out,i+1
    j=b.index(b':',i); n=int(b[i:j]); return b[j+1:j+1+n], j+1+n

data=open('collection.torrent','rb').read()
d,_=bdecode(data)
info=d[b'info']
print('announce', d.get(b'announce'))
print('name', info.get(b'name'))
print('piece length', info[b'piece length'])
print('pieces count', len(info[b'pieces'])//20)
print('private', info.get(b'private'))
for f in info[b'files']:
    print(f[b'length'], [p.decode() for p in f[b'path']])
EOF"

import urllib.request, urllib.parse, sys
def bencode(o):
    if isinstance(o,int): return b'i%de'%o
    if isinstance(o,bytes): return b'%d:'%len(o)+o
    if isinstance(o,str): return bencode(o.encode())
    if isinstance(o,list): return b'l'+b''.join(bencode(x) for x in o)+b'e'
    if isinstance(o,dict): return b'd'+b''.join(bencode(k)+bencode(v) for k,v in sorted(o.items()))+b'e'
def bdecode(b,i=0):
    c=b[i:i+1]
    if c==b'i':
        j=b.index(b'e',i); return int(b[i+1:j]), j+1
    if c==b'l':
        i+=1; out=[]
        while b[i:i+1]"'!=b'"'e':
            v,i=bdecode(b,i); out.append(v)
        return out,i+1
    if c==b'd':
        i+=1; out={}
        while b[i:i+1]"'!=b'"'e':
            k,i=bdecode(b,i); v,i=bdecode(b,i); out[k]=v
        return out,i+1
    j=b.index(b':',i); n=int(b[i:j]); return b[j+1:j+1+n], j+1+n
data=open('collection.torrent','rb').read()
d,_=bdecode(data)
info=d[b'info']
import hashlib
infohash=hashlib.sha1(bencode(info)).digest()
print('infohash', infohash.hex())
q={'info_hash':infohash,'peer_id':b'-X40AGT-'+b'0'*12,'port':6881,'uploaded':0,'downloaded':0,'left':sum(f[b'length'] for f in info[b'files']),'compact':1,'event':'started'}
url=d[b'announce'].decode()+'?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({k:(v.hex() if isinstance(v,bytes) else v) for k,v in q.items()})
# urlencode mangles bytes; build manually
import urllib.request
parts=[]
for k,v in [('info_hash',infohash),('peer_id',q['peer_id']),('port',b'6881'),('uploaded',b'0'),('downloaded',b'0'),('left',str(q['left']).encode()),('compact',b'1'),('event',b'started')]:
    parts.append(urllib.parse.quote_from_bytes(k.encode())+'='+urllib.parse.quote_from_bytes(v))
url=d[b'announce'].decode()+'?'+'&'.join(parts)
print(url)
try:
    r=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=10).read()
    print('resp', r[:300])
    resp,_=bdecode(r)
    print({k:(v if k"'!=b'"'peers' else (len(v)//6, v.hex())) for k,v in resp.items()})
except Exception as e:
    print('ERR', type(e).__name__, e)
EOF"
